input: # A description in several documents, given in `documents`, under the
# options that a case of test/docs/ cannot hold: `bundle` takes none of
# them, and every case there is bundled too.
# A document given as text that is a stream of two is refused, as a
# description is.
{"openapi":"3.1.0","info":{"title":"entry","version":"1"},"paths":{},"components":{"schemas":{"Never":{"$ref":"never.json"}}}}
# The output shapes hold across documents. Under `inline-once` the first
# reference to a target in another document holds it, and the next is kept
# as a reference.
{"openapi":"3.1.0","info":{"title":"entry","version":"1"},"paths":{},"components":{"schemas":{"A":{"$ref":"Pet.yaml"},"B":{"$ref":"Pet.yaml"}}}}
# And `xref` writes the reference as the document wrote it.
{"openapi":"3.1.0","info":{"title":"entry","version":"1"},"paths":{},"components":{"schemas":{"A":{"$ref":"Pet.yaml"},"B":{"$ref":"Pet.yaml"}}}}
# Under `strict` a reference that names nothing is refused wherever it is:
# in a schema of another document that only a mapping value names, under
# either way with cycles.
{"openapi":"3.1.0","info":{"title":"entry","version":"1"},"paths":{},"components":{"schemas":{"Pet":{"$ref":"dog.yaml#/Dog"}}}}
{"openapi":"3.1.0","info":{"title":"entry","version":"1"},"paths":{},"components":{"schemas":{"Pet":{"$ref":"dog.yaml#/Dog"}}}}
# The texts of a description's documents are held together to the size one
# text may have. Each of these is 400 bytes: two are read under a limit of
# 1,000, and the third of three is refused, in YAML and in JSON text, which
# `parse` reads without a limit when it is one text.
{"openapi":"3.1.0","info":{"title":"entry","version":"1"},"paths":{},"components":{"schemas":{"S0":{"$ref":"n0.yaml"},"S1":{"$ref":"n1.yaml"}}}}
{"openapi":"3.1.0","info":{"title":"entry","version":"1"},"paths":{},"components":{"schemas":{"S0":{"$ref":"n0.yaml"},"S1":{"$ref":"n1.yaml"},"S2":{"$ref":"n2.yaml"}}}}
{"openapi":"3.1.0","info":{"title":"entry","version":"1"},"paths":{},"components":{"schemas":{"S0":{"$ref":"n0.yaml"},"S1":{"$ref":"n1.yaml"}}}}
{"openapi":"3.1.0","info":{"title":"entry","version":"1"},"paths":{},"components":{"schemas":{"S0":{"$ref":"n0.yaml"},"S1":{"$ref":"n1.yaml"},"S2":{"$ref":"n2.yaml"}}}}
# A document given as a tree is no text, and is not counted.
{"openapi":"3.1.0","info":{"title":"entry","version":"1"},"paths":{},"components":{"schemas":{"S0":{"$ref":"n0.yaml"},"S1":{"$ref":"n1.yaml"},"S2":{"$ref":"n2.yaml"}}}}
